 Fresh from being announced as a Glastonbury headliner, the pop megastar has been confirmed for BST Hyde Park on July 3 2027
 Written by Ed Cunningham News and Features Editor, UK Friday 20 November 2026 Share Copy Link Facebook Twitter Pinterest Email WhatsApp Photograph: Henry Hwu | Billie Eilish Advertising Earlier this week Billie Eilish was announced as one of the headliners of Glastonbury 2027 . But that isn’t all that the UK is getting from the ‘Birds of a Feather’ and ‘Bad Guy’ singer next summer. Today (November 20), Eilish has been confirmed as the fourth headliner of BST Hyde Park 2027 .
 Billie’s set on the Great Oak Stage next summer will be her first ever appearance at BST. The 24-year-old joins Bon Jovi , Muse and RAYE in headlining the central London park’s series of day festivals.
 One of the planet’s biggest modern pop stars, Billie Eilish’s day at BST Hyde Park is not to be missed. Find out everything you need to know about getting tickets, including the general sale date, presales and ticket prices, below.
 When is Billie Eilish playing BST Hyde Park 2027? 
 Eilish’s headline date in Hyde Park is on Saturday July 3 2027 .
 Image: AEG Billie Eilish at BST Hyde Park 2027 
 When do Billie Eilish BST Hyde Park tickets go on sale? 
 General sale will go live at 10am on Thursday November 26 2026 . You’ll be able to buy on the BST Hyde Park website here .
 Presale details 
 There are four main presales to be in-the-know about. Here are the details:
 Amex presale (for American Express cardholders) – Friday November 20 at 3pm .
 Artist presale – Monday November 23 at 10am .
 BST presale ( sign up here ) – Tuesday November 24 at 10am .
 AEG presale – Wednesday November 25 at 10am .
 Ticket prices 
 According to Radio Times , pricing for the first release is as follows (not including booking fees):
 £104.15 (general admission)
 £114.85 (primary entry)
 £87.75 (child 2-9yrs + guardian)
 £128.45 (souvenir ticket bundle)
 £152.45 (premium bundle)
 £167.95 (gold circle)
 Who is supporting Billie Eilish at BST Hyde Park? 
 No support has yet been announced for Eilish’s BST date. A full supporting lineup will be announced closer to the date.
 Who else is headlining BST Hyde Park 2027? 
 Here’s the full lineup so far for next year’s edition of British Summer Time:
 Thursday June 24, 2027 – Bon Jovi
 Saturday June 26 2027 – Muse
 Saturday July 3 2027 – Billie Eilish 
 Saturday July 10 2027 – RAYE
 Sunday July 11 2027 – RAYE
 In 2026 the festival series was headlined by Garth Brooks , ATEEZ , Maroon 5 , Mumford & Sons , Duran Duran , Pitbull and Lewis Capaldi .
